: The company discontinued alcohol-monitoring hardware and software operations effective July 31 and has no intent to restart them.
: Workforce reductions and closure of the corporate office are expected to reduce annual operating costs by approximately $1.2 million.
: SOBR Safe and Clean World Ventures terminated their merger agreement on September 17.
: The company is evaluating alternatives, potentially including a business combination, asset sale or dissolution and liquidation.
